parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: Name of the user application recorded in the trace data. Exact match.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword. It will match on fields such as task name, application name (appName), task description, and evaluation metric name.

parameters.name: MaxTime
parameters.description: The UTC end time of the search time range

parameters.name: MinTime
parameters.description: The UTC start time of the search time range

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. Value range: integers greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: SamplingMethod
parameters.description: Sampling method for job data. Valid values are window or probability. Exact match.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: Field used to sort the return result. Supported fields: TaskId, CreateTime, TaskName, and Status. If not specified, results are sorted by CreateTime by default.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order of the return result. Valid values: ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). If not specified, results are sorted in descending order by default.
